description: Timed on-chain tile-merging puzzle with provably fair TEE-generated spawns. Pay a small GAS entry, tap a tile and an equal neighbour to merge (values double), and reach the target tile before the deadline to win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Easy (reach 64), 0.5 for Medium (reach 256), 1 for Hard (reach 1024). Each spawn is revealed one move at a time inside a Morpheus TEE session — the future board is never handed to the client. Winnings accrue as withdrawable credit and every solve is ranked on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 限时链上合并方块益智游戏，方块生成由 TEE 保证可验证公平。支付少量 GAS 报名费，点击一个方块和相邻的相同方块进行合并（数值翻倍），在截止时间前达到目标方块即可赢取固定 GAS 奖励：简单 0.1（达到 64）、中等 0.5（达到 256）、困难 1（达到 1024）。每次生成的新方块在 Morpheus TEE 会话中逐步揭示——未来的棋盘永不交给客户端。奖金以可提取余额累计，每次通关都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: The board and its spawn stream are generated inside a Morpheus TEE enclave from a deterministic per-game secret. Only the hash commitment is bound on-chain at the start; the enclave reveals the next spawn tile and cell one move at a time (2048-style), so the future board never leaves the TEE. At settlement the enclave replays the recorded merges over its own spawn stream and signs the highest tile reached after checking the commitment.

tee.description: The play session is verified by Morpheus TEE compute before settlement, with the contract bound to the configured Morpheus oracle kernel on testnet.
